reviewer_items.item: 3P pouch: the hand fetches the new magazine from the bare belly (magic spawn)

reviewer_items.item: 3P white blotches on the black left upper arm pressed to the chest
reviewer_items.action: measured: present with the probe's 30000-unit fill light (also with its specular at 0), absent with the game's lighting, where the arm is not black at all (the capture's auto exposure darkened everything the fill light did not hit); no torso through the sleeve in the game-lit frames. reviewer_items.item: 3P charge: the hand rests on the receiver top, no pull or release readable from the front-left

Fixed: the hand lets go at the rear, stays 0.05 s while the handle runs forward, lifts off up and out, then returns. Filmed from the right (the handle's side) and from the player's view

reviewer_items.item: FP left hand on the handguard: a flat white paddle, the tan wrist end-on as a disc
reviewer_items.action: fixed: first-person hold (hand_l turned -35 deg about the handguard axis, palm kept on SupportHand 0.30 cm): the thumb lies along the handguard, the palm under it, the wrist lower and no longer end-on. The UEFN hand's fingers are still one block (the mesh)

reviewer_items.item: FP ADS: the wrist ball intrudes into the sight picture; receiver top blotchy

method: Measure (g10e_measure_game.py: hand / socket / pouch transforms, lighting A/B on the reviewer's frames), C++ (UNinjaGunComponent: visible pouch with PouchMount on spine_02 and the 3P hand path taking the pouch magazine; charge release hold + lift; FP hold FirstPersonSupportHand* through the existing GunHandRotCS / IK path; UNinjaGunLegsComponent poseable copy for FP legs), runtime tuning of the pouch and the FP hold (g10e_tune_game.py, two rounds), then the final film and gates (g10e_reload_probe_game.py, g10e_fp_views_game.py) on the final binaries, sheets by g10e_contact_sheet.py, play test x3 + g9.
honest_notes: No content asset was changed (C++ and tool scripts only). The pouch is built at run time from the engine cube and the range's surface material (M_Range_Surface, olive Color); for a packaged build the two soft references (PouchBoxMesh, PouchMaterial) must be cooked (referenced from a cooked asset or always-cook list).
The pouch is two boxes and a back panel: it reads as a magazine carrier at game distance but is a placeholder, not a modelled pouch (no flaps, straps or stitching).
The taken magazine re-appears in the pouch when the reload ends (an endless pouch), usually off camera from the shoulder view.
The FP hand path still goes to its own off-screen pouch point (FirstPersonPouchOffset), not to the 3P pouch on the real body; only visible if a player looks down during a V reload.
The UEFN hand's fingers stay one rounded block (the mannequin mesh); the FP hold shows the thumb but not separate fingers.
The AR-01 receiver top's paint-wear pattern looks coarse at ADS distance; it is the asset's texture (unchanged with all textures fully loaded), out of this stage's scope.
Script prefix g10e_ here = reload round 3 tools; the plan's future free-look stage (G10e) is a different stage.

The first G10e probe run returned guard exit 6 because I edited tool / source comments while it ran; every final result (views, probe, 3 play tests, g9) ran after the final build with 0 snapshot differences.
